# Pinned Playwright Go source subset

APEX carries a bounded source subset of `github.com/mxschmitt/playwright-go v0.6100.0`. Native driver and browser pins remain unchanged.

See the [APEX patch contract](APEX_PATCHES.md), [MIT license](LICENSE), [source provenance manifest](UPSTREAM_MANIFEST.json), and [pinned upstream documentation](https://github.com/mxschmitt/playwright-go/blob/v0.6100.0/README.md). The [verbatim upstream README](README.upstream.txt) preserves its original bytes; its relative links refer to upstream examples and assets outside this subset.
